summary: 28-year-old hiker fell about 10 feet in the S.O.B. Gully toward the bottom of the North Rim, Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP, suffering a compound leg fracture; rangers and a paramedic spent the night with him; Black Canyon Volunteer SAR, park personnel, Western State Colorado University SAR and West Elk SAR raised him 1,400 vertical feet via 11 main-and-belay line stations of ~130 ft each; flown by Tri State Care Flight to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction
location: S.O.B. Gully (North Rim), Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
responding_agency: Black Canyon Volunteer SAR; Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP; Western State Colorado University SAR; West Elk SAR
notes: NPS morning report dated 2014-07-11; incident Saturday 2014-07-05; evacuation staged at first light
